Bill.BriefDescription: Discouraging pre-college courses at public four-year institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to discouraging precollege courses at public fouryear institutions of higher education; adding a new section to chapter28B.10 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that an unacceptablyhigh number of students entering institutions of higher education areunprepared to do college level mathematics, reading, or writing, andrequire remedial instruction. This remedial instruction imposesadditional costs and burdens on students by increasing the time ittakes for them to reach their educational goals, and increases thestate's costs associated with higher education.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Precollege coursework offered in mathematics, reading, writing, orEnglish, except for English courses offered for English languagelearners, shall be offered on a selfsupporting basis at stateuniversities, regional universities, and The Evergreen State College.If a state or regional university or state college chooses to operate p. 1 HB 1336a selfsupporting precollege program, the fees charged shall besufficient to cover the direct costs of instruction, which areinstructional salaries and related benefits, supplies, publications,and records.
